observations.evidence: Top patterns: decimal(34,2) / decimal(34,3) / decimal(34,4) / decimal(34,6) / decimal(32,3) / decimal(36,4).
observations.impact: DEV uses 34/32/36 digits of precision (SQL Server default for unannotated decimal).
observations.decisionReasoning: Over-precision. GuliERP may want tighter (20,X) or (18,X) — a design decision.

observations.evidence: 金额, 总金额, 标准成本, 借, 贷, CNY借, CNY贷 all decimal(34,2).
observations.impact: 2 decimal places for money matches China accounting standard (0.01 CNY).

observations.evidence: 商品表.单价 decimal(36,4) vs 报价表s.单价 decimal(34,6) — same semantic, two different scales.
observations.impact: Inconsistency in DEV. GuliERP must DECLARE ONE per semantic type.
observations.decisionReasoning: Pick-one decision belongs to GuliERP Convention.

observations.evidence: 数量, 外箱数, 长/宽/高, 母件 all decimal(34,3) or decimal(32,3).
observations.impact: 3 decimals for quantity matches kg (0.001 kg = 1 g).
BOM usage quantity at 6 decimals (0.000001 unit per finished good).
6 decimals for exchange rate matches standard FX convention.

observations.evidence: No DEV source carries RoundingMode. .NET Math.Round default (AwayFromZero) is implicit client behavior, NOT used as evidence here.
observations.impact: GuliERP must DECLARE rounding per semantic type. (Cross-ref BASE-000 UNC-005.)

observations.evidence: 商品表.工价 = 0.0000, 数量 = 1.000 — store at full declared precision, display via client formatting.
observations.impact: EF Core mapping: precision must match SQL numeric(P,S) to avoid silent truncation.

must_decide: AMOUNT: scale 2 (matches DEV pattern) vs scale 4 (HALF_EVEN safety for tax math)
UNIT_PRICE: 4 (商品表 pattern) vs 6 (报价表s pattern) — pick one
QUANTITY: scale 3 (kg pattern) vs 6 (BOM pattern) — distinguish StockQty vs BOMUsageQty
RoundingMode: per-semantic-type declaration required (ROUNDING_MODE_NOT_FOUND in DEV)
Rounding moments: line / document / tax / posting — 4 separate rules
